A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 23-page versions of the same SSNI paper. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–L support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original SSNI experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K, including robustness evaluations, ablations, inference timings, and purification visualizations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–12 and the appendix analyses and visualizations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same score-based noise adjustment, EPS computation, linear and nonlinear reweighting functions, and bias term. Figure 3's revised illustrations do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate clean and adversarial classification on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K under the same attack scenarios. The replacement images in the framework schematic do not establish additional training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain DiffPure (Nie et al., 2022), GDMP (Wang et al., 2022), and GNS (Lee and Kim, 2023). The sampling-method ablation also retains the same sdeint, DDPM, and DDIM alternatives.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices C–F retain the same 512-image evaluation subsets, classifier configurations, attack budgets and iterations, metrics, and surrogate-gradient procedures. No experimental setting or evaluation protocol is revised.

E4.justification: The temperature, sampling-method, score-norm, bias-term, and architecture ablations remain unchanged in Section 5.5 and Appendices H–J. The motivating analyses and Appendix L purification examples are also retained.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same reporting of means and standard deviations over three runs. No repeated-run information, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance testing is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–12 retain identical result entries, and the empirical plots and Appendix L images are unchanged. For example, Table 1's DiffPure plus SSNI-N on WRN-28-10 retains 93.29±0.37 standard accuracy and 48.63±0.56 robust accuracy under PGD+EOT with an 8/255 infinity-norm budget. Figure 3 changes illustrative examples rather than reported experimental findings.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in the main text, the purification-range arguments in Appendix B, and the definitions, lemmas, proposition, proofs, and remark in Appendix K are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: sample-specific noise levels derived from score norms, integration with existing purification methods, and improved accuracy–robustness trade-offs. No central claim is added, strengthened, or narrowed.

C2.justification: Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning the shared EPS upper bound, potentially suboptimal reweighting functions, and extra computation. V2 adds brief future-work suggestions, including learned reweighting functions, but no distinct limitation, applicability boundary, or substantive reinterpretation of results.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, validation-data description, software versions, hardware, timings, and appendix configurations are unchanged. V2's added repository link in Section 5.6 repeats the link already present in both abstracts and supplies no new access or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The introduction replaces Finlayson et al. (2019), on medical machine-learning attacks, with Han et al. (2025), Trustworthy Machine Learning: From Data to Models. The retitled Zhang reference remains the same work, identifiable by arXiv 2503.02169. These are limited citation changes without a substantive repositioning of SSNI.

P1.justification: V2 lightly expands Section 6's future-work wording, adds a funding acknowledgment for Chaowei Xiao, repeats the code link, and updates bibliographic wording. The section organization and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is revised with different illustrative images and Hummingbird, Goose, and Wombat labels replacing Cat, Bird, and Dog. Table 3 moves from the right to the left column on page 7, with accompanying text reflow. The remaining figure and table content is retained.

improvement.justification: Figure 3 presents the same workflow with different illustrative examples, while Section 6 elaborates limitations already acknowledged in v1. These edits and the citation/layout adjustments provide limited editorial polish without materially changing clarity, scientific support, or reproducibility. The paper's substantive strengths and limitations remain essentially unchanged.
